theater: 巴比倫與蘇薩（兩河中下游）

battle.name: 沙馬什·舒姆·烏金
battle.theater: 巴比倫與蘇薩（兩河中下游）
battle.brief: 公元前652年，亞述巴尼拔的弟弟、巴比倫王沙馬什·舒姆·烏金舉兵反叛，埃蘭與米太各站一方：亞述聯軍圍巴比倫、埃蘭聯軍守蘇薩，圍城約四年，城破之日統治者與城同亡。卡面埃及月牙劍不在這場戰役的戰場上，它是青銅時代埃及的禮器象徵，指向亞述霸權西緣那條過時的兵器譜系。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰雙方，是亞述帝國與以巴比倫為核心的聯盟。亞述一方以首都尼尼微的王家軍為骨幹，配屬各行省的守備部隊與工兵隊：王家重裝步兵列高身柳條盾（阿卡德語 gintu）前進，弓箭手以亞述弓覆蓋，輕裝騎兵與雙輪戰車擔任追擊與包圍，攻城技師則駕著撞木、箭塔與土木壘器械。圍城期間亞述巴尼拔另立自己的幼弟為亞述王坐鎮尼尼微，免得首都被端，這是亞述王室處理遠征危機的固定手法。北方盟友是米太，其騎兵配短弓與長矛，是圍城聯軍中唯一能在野外迅速調動的機動兵力，專責封鎖道路、截擊糧隊；編年史殘片另提到圍城期間有北方部眾趁亂進入兩河下游。叛方是巴比倫王國的城防軍與南部行省的部眾，由沙馬什·舒姆·烏金以馬爾杜克神廟的合法權威號召，指揮權集中於國王與少數將領之手，沒有可與亞述抗衡的參謀體系。埃蘭站在叛方一邊：蘇薩的國王梯曼在叛亂前夜被自己人推翻，其子 Tammaritu 掌權後同樣不願臣服亞述，遂與巴比倫合流。於是戰爭拉成兩條並行的線：亞述聯軍圍巴比倫，亞述分兵攻蘇薩。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the Assyrian empire and a coalition built around Babylon. The Assyrian side rested on the royal army of Nineveh, reinforced by provincial garrison troops and by corps of engineers: armoured infantry advanced behind tall wicker shields (gintu in Akkadian), archers covered them with the Assyrian bow, light cavalry and two-wheeled chariots provided pursuit and envelopment, and siege engineers brought battering rams, arrow towers and earthen siege works. While the siege was being conducted, Ashurbanipal had one of his younger brothers enthroned as king at Nineveh so that the capital would not stand without a ruler; this was standard Assyrian practice when a campaign pulled the king far from home. The Medes joined on the Assyrian side: their horse-archers and lancers were the only mobile force the besiegers could throw across open country, and they were used to seal the roads and intercept relief columns. Fragments of the Babylonian Chronicle also hint that northern peoples moved into Babylonia while the city was sealed, taking advantage of the fighting. The rebel side was the garrison of Babylon together with the peoples of the southern provinces, called up by Shamash-shum-ukin under the authority of the temple of Marduk; command was concentrated in the king and a handful of officers, with no staff system comparable to the Assyrian one. Elam stood with the rebels. The king of Susa, Teumman, had been overthrown by his own people shortly before the rising, and his son Tammaritu, once master of Elam, was equally unwilling to remain subject to Assyria, so Elam made common cause with Babylon. The war therefore ran on two axes at once: a siege of Babylon and a contest for Susa.
people: 沙馬什·舒姆·烏金，名字的意思是「沙馬什是王權的確立者」，是亞述巴尼拔的弟弟，公元前668年以宗室身份被立為巴比倫王，統治約十六年。他並非用兵奪位，因此起兵時在法理上可以自稱把王位從被褫奪者手中取回；史料把他寫成一個長期受壓抑、最後走投無路的君主。他是這場圍城裡唯一留下名字的主角，古文獻記載城破之時他不曾出逃，而是留在城內直到與城同亡，死法則眾說紛紜，有的說自焚，有的說被殺。亞述巴尼拔，公元前669至631年在位四十二年，是亞述最後一位真正稱霸的君主，這場叛亂迫使他把兵馬與注意力從埃及、埃蘭抽回尼尼微方向；他晚年的宮廷同時是規模空前的抄經中心，宮室收藏與文本活動都處於頂點。埃蘭方面，梯曼與其子 Tammaritu 是關鍵人物：梯曼被自己人推翻，Tammaritu 在公元前654至653年間投奔巴比倫，蘇薩淪陷後被亞述俘獲。米太國王的名字在殘存的編年史裡不可考，希臘史料為他取的名字屬於更晚的君主，不宜直接套用。巴比倫這邊，叛軍首腦在城破後被清除，亞述巴尼拔改立沙馬什·舒姆·烏金的弟弟繼位；此人在亞述巴尼拔死後不久被殺，其子 Nabopolassar 於公元前626年登位，公開脫離亞述。記述這場戰爭的同時代文本主要留下編年史殘片、《列王紀下》與《耶利米書》的相關段落、《以斯拉續篇上》6:29至30與《以斯拉續篇下》13，以及約瑟夫斯《古史》10.3.4。
peopleEn: Shamash-shum-ukin, whose name means 'Shamash is the establisher of kingship', was a brother of Ashurbanipal and was installed as king of Babylon in 668 BC, ruling for roughly sixteen years. He had taken the throne by dynastic appointment rather than by force, so when he rose he could claim in law that he was recovering a kingship from those who had stripped it from him; the sources paint him as a man worn down by long frustration who finally ran out of options. He is the only principal of the siege who is named in the records, and the ancient accounts say that when the city fell he did not flee but stayed inside and died with it, though how he died is given variously, some saying by his own hand and some that he was killed. Ashurbanipal, king from 669 to 631 BC and forty-two years on the throne, was the last Assyrian ruler to be a hegemon in his own lifetime; the revolt forced him to pull troops and attention back from Egypt and Elam towards Nineveh, and his late palace was at the same time the centre of an enormous programme of scribal copying, with the royal collections and textual work at their height. On the Elamite side two men matter: Teumman and his son Tammaritu. Teumman was overthrown by his own people, and Tammaritu, once master of Elam, threw in his lot with Babylon between 654 and 653 BC and was captured by the Assyrians after the fall of Susa. The name of the Median king is lost in the surviving chronicle fragments; the Greek name belongs to a later ruler and should not be applied retroactively. On the Babylonian side the rebel leadership was destroyed when the city fell, and Ashurbanipal put Shamash-shum-ukin's brother on the throne; that man was killed shortly after Ashurbanipal's death, and his son Nabopolassar took the crown in 626 BC and broke openly with Assyria. The near-contemporary texts that preserve the war are the chronicle fragments, the relevant passages of Kings and Jeremiah, 1 Esdras 6:29-30, 4 Ezra 13, and Josephus, Antiquities 10.3.4.
kits: 卡面兵器是埃及月牙劍（khopesh）：青銅時代埃及的外彎單刃鐮形劍，形制可追溯至納卡達與阿拜多斯的王墓出土品，盛期在公元前1500年前後，刃口內彎如鐮，砍入軟甲或血肉之後可順勢鉤拉，不必像直劍那樣回收，因此特別適合斬腿、割喉與扯開皮甲。到公元前652年，此劍已過約八個半世紀；埃及自公元前667年起淪為亞述行省，埃及軍隊早已不用它作戰，它退成王權與神廟的禮器，並以 khepesh 一詞進入阿卡德語，成為「劍」的通用詞，也出現在亞述宮廷收藏的埃及戰利品與浮雕之中。真正決定這場圍城的裝備是亞述與巴比倫的常規軍械：近身砍殺靠青銅或鐵的短直劍、單刃斧與戰錘（阿卡德語 pāzu）、長矛（anzû，槍首為鐵或青銅，柄用榛木或竹）與長矛（lukha）；防護用圓盾（kakku）、小圓盾（šēru）與高身柳條盾（gintu）；遠程是亞述弓與米太短弓，埃蘭弓配箭袋使用；攻城側有撞木、箭塔、環城壕溝與土木壘（hārū），以及從牆基掘進的地道。押運與補給靠牛車、口糧與水，圍城圈拉得越長，糧秣消耗越大。於是月牙劍在這場戰役中的位置不在戰場，而在象徵層面：它代表亞述霸權西緣那一條早已作廢的兵器譜系，也代表亞述王室在宮室裡陳列的「被征服行省」記號。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Egyptian khopesh, a curved single-edged sickle sword of the Egyptian Bronze Age. Its form is documented by finds from the royal tombs at Naqada and Abydos, and its high period falls around 1500 BC. The blade curves inward like a sickle, so that once it has bitten into soft armour or flesh it can be drawn along the cut instead of having to be pulled back, which makes it well suited to slashing legs, cutting throats and tearing open leather armour. By 652 BC the khopesh was some eight and a half centuries old. Egypt had been an Assyrian province since 667 BC, and the Egyptian army had long since stopped fighting with it; it had retreated into the regalia of kingship and the temple, entered Akkadian as the general word for a sword (khepesh), and appeared among the Egyptian spoils and reliefs displayed in Assyrian palaces. What actually decided the siege was the ordinary armament of the Assyrians and Babylonians. Close combat rested on bronze and iron short swords, single-edged axes and the mace (pazu in Akkadian), on the spear (anzu, with an iron or bronze head on a hazel or bamboo shaft) and on the long lance (lukha). Protection came from the round shield (kakku), the small round shield (seru) and the tall wicker shield (gintu). Missile work was done with the Assyrian bow and the short Median bow, while the Elamite bow was used with its quiver. The siege train included battering rams, arrow towers, a continuous encircling trench and earthen siege works (haru), plus mines driven in under the foundations. Everything moved on ox carts, and the longer the cordon was drawn, the more grain and water it consumed. The khopesh therefore has no place on the battlefield in this war. It sits on the symbolic level: it stands for the long obsolete weapon lineage on the western edge of the Assyrian hegemony, and for the display in the Assyrian palace of the sign of a conquered province.
tactics: 亞述人沒有急於強攻，而是用標準的亞述式圍城：先拉出連續的壕溝與土木柵把城圍成一圈，在壕溝內側築起高壘（hārū）逼近牆根，再在壘上架設撞木與箭塔，同時派工兵自牆基掘地道。巴比倫的護城河直接取水於幼發拉底河，因此守住兩岸渡口、水門與河道就是守城的第一要務，亞述聯軍也把封鎖水路與糧道列為重點。米太騎兵在城郊游弋，負責切斷援軍通道與護送攻城器械的車隊；埃蘭與巴比倫的聯軍則在蘇薩一線周旋，並試圖打通通往埃蘭高原的道路，把糧援與兵員送入被圍的巴比倫。守方把城牆視為主體，依托高厚牆體與塔樓以弓覆蓋城頭，閉死水門，同時準備在撞木接近時做反衝擊的處置。圍城進入第三年，城內存糧見底，軍隊開始宰殺馬匹充飢，攻城方則以定期襲擊消耗守軍士氣，封鎖線之外的糧價與人口流動都被切斷。蘇薩方面，亞述分兵在城下築壘圍城，同時掃清埃蘭境內的村鎮，逼 Tammaritu 出降。最終局面是城破：亞述軍破門而入，統治者隨城而亡，亞述軍在市中劫掠並搬走大批器物與泥板。
tacticsEn: The Assyrians did not rush the walls. They fell back on the standard Assyrian form of siege: a continuous trench and timber palisade drawn around the city, earthen siege works (haru) raised inside the trench to close on the foot of the wall, battering rams and arrow towers mounted on those works, and sappers driving mines in under the foundations. The moat of Babylon drew its water from the Euphrates, so holding the crossings, the water gates and the river itself was the first duty of the defence, and sealing the waterways and the grain roads was correspondingly central to the Assyrian plan. Median horse rode around the outskirts, cutting off relief columns and escorting the siege train; the Elamite and Babylonian allies meanwhile manoeuvred on the Susa front and tried to open a road towards the Elamite highlands in order to get grain and fighting men into the sealed city. The defenders treated the wall itself as the main armament, covering the ramparts with bows from the towers, shutting the water gates, and preparing countermeasures for the moment the rams reached the wall. By the third year the food inside the city had run out and the garrison was killing its horses for meat, while the besiegers kept up periodic assaults to wear down the defenders and sealed the cordon so tightly that prices and the movement of people outside the walls were strangled. On the Susa front the Assyrians divided off a detachment to raise siege works before the city while clearing the villages of Elam, pressing Tammaritu towards surrender. The end came with the storming of the city: the Assyrians broke in, the ruler died with the place, and the troops looted the streets and carried off large quantities of objects and clay tablets.
data: 時序上，起事在公元前652年，京城陷落約在公元前648年，圍城歷時約四年；亞述巴尼拔在位四十二年（公元前669至631年），沙馬什·舒姆·烏金在巴比倫約十六年（公元前668至652年），蘇薩陷落在公元前647年，埃蘭滅國在公元前646年。城池方面，巴比倫城牆周長約十八公里，高約二十米、頂寬約六至七米，護城河與幼發拉底河相連，內城與外城之間有埃薩吉拉神廟區與王宮區的分隔。人口方面，學界估算差距甚大，通常落在數萬量級，約四萬至十萬之間的不同說法都有。疆域方面，亞述巴尼拔時代的帝國版圖約四百萬至五百萬平方公里，橫跨數十個行省與多種語言區。軍力方面，現存史料沒有留下攻城雙方的確定兵力數字，亞述浮雕與銘文能反映各兵種的編制構成，但並不作具體人數統計。文本方面，《以斯拉續篇上》6:30 把圍城繫於尼布甲尼撒第二十三至二十四年，《以斯拉續篇下》13 記有長期圍城與城中饑饉，而《列王紀下》25 與《耶利米書》52 裡詳細的圍城描述多數屬於公元前597年與前587年尼布甲尼撒的兩次圍城，不能直接套用到本場戰役。編年史殘片另提到北方部眾趁圍城之際進入巴比倫地區，但僅存數行。
dataEn: As to chronology, the rising belongs to 652 BC and the fall of the capital to about 648 BC, so the siege ran for roughly four years. Ashurbanipal reigned forty-two years, from 669 to 631 BC; Shamash-shum-ukin ruled Babylon for about sixteen years, from 668 to 652; Susa fell in 647 BC, and Elam was destroyed in 646. As to the city, the circuit of the walls of Babylon ran to roughly eighteen kilometres, the wall standing about twenty metres high and six to seven metres thick at the top, with a moat fed from the Euphrates, and the sacred quarter of Esagila divided from the royal quarter of the Peristyle. On population the estimates differ widely and are usually given in the tens of thousands, figures between roughly forty thousand and one hundred thousand all being defended. As to territory, the empire under Ashurbanipal covered something in the order of four to five million square kilometres across dozens of provinces and several language groups. As to strength, the surviving sources preserve no reliable figure for the size of either besieging or defending force; Assyrian reliefs and inscriptions show the composition of the army by arm, but no head-counts. As to the texts, 1 Esdras 6:30 attaches the siege to the twenty-third and twenty-fourth years of Nebuchadnezzar, and 4 Ezra 13 records a long siege and famine inside the city, while the detailed siege narratives in 2 Kings 25 and Jeremiah 52 belong mostly to the two Nebuchadnezzarian sieges of 597 and 587 BC and cannot simply be transferred to this war. The chronicle fragments add that northern peoples entered the Babylonian region during the siege, but only a few lines survive.
cause: 直接導火線並沒有留下記載，後世只能從結構上推想。第一層是王室的屈辱：沙馬什·舒姆·烏金是亞述巴尼拔的弟弟，卻被安置在巴比倫這個帝國核心行省當附庸，亞述王對巴比倫的宮室與神廟保持嚴密監視，對本地貴族屢加打壓，這份怨氣在亞述巴尼拔於公元前655年平定埃及再叛、又把重兵壓在埃蘭戰線的同時集中爆發。第二層是宗教與文化層面：亞述巴尼拔在埃蘭、阿拉伯一線拆掠神廟的做法，連帶加深了巴比倫馬爾杜克祭司集團對亞述的不滿，起兵因此不只是一場政變，而被敘述成恢復神權秩序的行動。第三層是地理與戰略層面：亞述主力分散在埃及、埃蘭與敘利亞，巴比倫南部行省的守備空虛，埃蘭王梯曼在公元前654至653年被自己人推翻、其子 Tammaritu 反亞述，兩國因此合流。第四層是米太的加入：米太自從先前的敗仗之後對巴比倫懷怨，此時趁亞述西線吃緊而站到聯軍一邊，改變了力量對比，使巴比倫從守城的一方變成有能力分兵支援蘇薩的一方。
causeEn: No direct spark has been recorded, and the causes can only be reconstructed structurally. The first layer is the humiliation of the royal house: Shamash-shum-ukin was a brother of Ashurbanipal yet was set up as a dependent in Babylon, the heart of the empire, while the Assyrian king kept the Babylonian court and its temples under tight surveillance and repeatedly repressed the local aristocracy; that resentment came to a head at the moment when Ashurbanipal had just crushed an Egyptian revolt in 655 BC and was simultaneously committing his main force to the Elamite front. The second layer is religious and cultural: the destruction of temples on the Elamite and Arabian fronts stained the Assyrian king in Babylonian eyes and deepened the alienation of the Marduk priesthood in Babylon, so the rising could be presented not as a coup but as the restoration of a proper religious order. The third layer is geographic and strategic: the Assyrian army was dispersed between Egypt, Elam and Syria, the southern Babylonian provinces were thinly held, and the Elamite king Teumman was overthrown by his own people in 654-653 BC while his son Tammaritu refused to submit, so the two states converged. The fourth layer is the Medes: mindful of an earlier defeat at Babylonian hands they took the Assyrian enemy's side as the western front grew hard, and their entry altered the balance of forces, turning Babylon from a besieged city into a partner able to spare forces for Susa.
impact: 短期看，亞述保住了巴比倫，代價卻是四年重兵消耗與西線兵力的連續分散；城破之後巴比倫王室被清洗，亞述巴尼拔改立沙馬什·舒姆·烏金的弟弟，此人日後被殺，其子 Nabopolassar 才於公元前626年取得王位並公開反叛。埃蘭線上，亞述在公元前647年洗劫蘇薩，把埃蘭的財富與人力一併掠走，此後埃蘭淪為行省，但公元前646年埃蘭再度舉兵，最終被亞述軍滅國，代價慘重，此後近半個世紀亞述在西南亞洲再無遠征能力，黎凡特與埃及的反叛得以喘息。制度層面上，王室正統性受損，亞述需靠宮廷祭祀、文本抄寫與對被征服省份的象徵展示來維持秩序，尼尼微的抄經活動在這些年達到頂峰，而巴比倫城破時被帶走的泥板與器物，有一部分日後出現在尼尼微的收藏裡。長期看，這場圍城是巴比倫第一次以主動姿態挑戰亞述霸權，開啟了後來新巴比倫獨立的道路，也讓亞述西部的體系在二十餘年後被米太與巴比倫聯手終結（公元前612年尼尼微陷落），而巴比倫自身也在公元前586年亡於新巴比倫帝國。
impactEn: In the short term Assyria kept Babylon, but it paid for that in four years of heavy troops committed and in a continuous dispersal of its western forces. After the fall the Babylonian royal house was purged, Ashurbanipal put Shamash-shum-ukin's brother on the throne, that man was later killed, and only his son Nabopolassar reached the crown in 626 BC and broke away in earnest. On the Elamite front Assyria sacked Susa in 647 BC, carrying off Elam's wealth and manpower, and Elam became a province, but it rose once more in 646 BC and was destroyed by the Assyrian army at great cost; for roughly half a century afterwards Assyria had no capacity for distant campaigns in the Levant, and the revolts of Lebanon and Egypt could breathe. On the institutional level the legitimacy of the crown was dented, and the dynasty had to hold things together through court ritual, scribal copying and the display of the symbols of conquered provinces; the copying programme at Nineveh peaked in these very years, and some of the tablets and objects carried off from Babylon turned up later in the collections of Nineveh. In the long run this siege was Babylon's first active challenge to the Assyrian hegemony, and it opened the road that ended in the independence of the Neo-Babylonian state; the western system of Assyria was destroyed a little more than twenty years later by Medes and Babylonians together when Nineveh fell in 612 BC, and Babylon itself was destroyed in 586 BC by the empire it had just won.
result: 公元前648年前後巴比倫城破，延續約四年的圍城結束。沙馬什·舒姆·烏金死在城破之時，古文獻對他的死法說法不一，或稱在王宮自焚，或稱混戰中被殺，細節互相矛盾。亞述軍入城劫掠，重新佔有巴比倫，卻沒有消除城中的怨憤：亞述在此後仍須靠另立傀儡維持巴比倫的統治，而傀儡接連被殺，直到 Nabopolassar 於公元前626年登位才真正擺脫亞述。埃蘭線上，亞述自公元前653年起用兵數年，最終在公元前647年攻下蘇薩，並於公元前646年滅埃蘭，西線自此被拖到極限，亞述巴尼拔其後十多年都在西線作戰，再也無力把勢力推回埃及與黎凡特。就卡面兵器而言，埃及月牙劍沒有出現在這場戰役的任何一個環節：它是青銅時代埃及的遺物，到公元前652年已是王權與被征服行省的象徵，只隨亞述王室的戰利品陳列與浮雕一同存在於尼尼微宮廷；而它真正指示的，是亞述霸權西緣那一條已經停止更新的兵器譜系——這條線上的武器屬於一個比亞述帝國更早的時代，也屬於即將被米太人與新巴比倫人取代的時代。
resultEn: Babylon fell at about 648 BC, ending a siege that had run for roughly four years. Shamash-shum-ukin died in the fall of the city, and the ancient accounts disagree about how: some say he set fire to himself in the palace, some that he was killed in the fighting, and the details contradict one another. The Assyrians entered the city, looted it, and took possession of Babylon again, but did not remove the bitterness there: Assyria could now hold Babylon only by installing a puppet, and the puppets were killed one after another until Nabopolassar took the throne in 626 BC and genuinely broke free. On the Elamite front Assyria fought for several years from 653 BC, took Susa in 647, and destroyed Elam in 646, which stretched the western front to the limit; Ashurbanipal spent the whole of the following decade campaigning in the west and never again drove power back into Egypt or the Levant. As for the weapon on the card, the Egyptian khopesh appears at no point in this war: it was a relic of the Egyptian Bronze Age, by 652 BC a symbol of kingship and of a conquered province, surviving only among the spoils displayed in the Assyrian palace and in its reliefs. What it really points to is the weapon lineage on the western edge of Assyrian hegemony, a line that had stopped being updated long before and belonged to a world that Medes and Neo-Babylonians were about to replace.
